quest.title: Help Mr. Page fill the library

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Hello! I am Mr. Page. This is my <color=red>library</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Everyone loves my books. It is too <color=red>busy</color> here!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: They all took books home. But no one came <color=red>back</color>!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Now my shelves are <color=red>empty</color>. Oh dear!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus can help. Go and <color=red>talk</color> to them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Help all three, and my books will come <color=red>home</color>!

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Go and help Barnaby, Tilly and Gus. Then come back to <color=red>me</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped all my friends. I am so <color=red>happy</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: <color=red>Thank you</color>! You are a real book hero.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: My library is full of <color=red>books</color> again. I am so happy. Come and read any time!
